[[Club Atlético Vélez Sarsfield|Vélez Sarsfield]] | league topscorer = | biggest home win = | biggest away win= | highest scoring= | prevseason=[[1990–91 Argentine Primera División|1990–91]] | nextseason=[[1992–93 Argentine Primera División|1992–93]] }} The '''1991–92 [[Argentine Primera División]]''' was the 101st season of top-flight professional [[football in Argentina]]. Starting with this season, both [[Apertura and Clausura]] tournaments were recognised as separate championships, and no final decider was played between the winners of each tournament. [[Club Atlético River Plate|River Plate]] won the Apertura and [[Newell's Old Boys]] won the Clausura. The season ran from 10 September 1991 to 5 July 1992, with [[Quilmes Atlético Club|Quilmes]] and [[Unión de Santa Fe]] being relegated.[https://www.rsssf.org/tablesa/arg92.html Argentina 1991–92] by Pablo Ciullini on RSSSF.com ==Competition format== The tournament for the 1991–92 season was composed of 20 teams. Each team played each other in a single [[round-robin tournament]]. The season was divided in two separate championships, called ''Apertura'' (Opening) and ''Clausura'' (Closing). If each tournament was won by a different team, they played a two-legged qualifier for the [[1993 Copa Libertadores]]. To decide the remaining berth for the Copa Libertadores, the four runners-up from the ''Apertura'' tournaments and the four runners-up from the ''Clausura'' tournament (not already qualified in the ''Apertura'' tournament) competed in an eight-team knockout round. The winning team played against the losing team from the two-legged qualifier and was granted a berth in the [[1993 Copa Libertadores]]. The losing team plus the finalist and best semi-finalist of the eight-team knockout round competed in the [[1992 Copa CONMEBOL]]. Relegation occurred at the end of the Clausura stage, with the two teams with the worst three-year point average (Primera División competition only) being relegated to [[Primera B Nacional]] competition. == Apertura Tournament== {{Infobox football league season | competition = Apertura | image = River equipo 1991 apertura.jpg | pixels = | alt = | caption = River Plate, Apertura champions | season = 1991 | dates = 29 August – 22 December | winners = [[Club Atlético River Plate|River Plate]] | shieldtitle = | shield = | premiers = | promoted = [[Quilmes Atlético Club|Quilmes]] [[File:Green Arrow Up.svg|10px]]
